items.quote: Möchten Sie die Entscheidung anfechten, erheben Sie Widerspruch – innerhalb eines Monats, gerechnet ab der Bekanntgabe, schriftlich, elektronisch mit qualifizierter Signatur oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Nordmuster, Kreishaus, Marktstraße 1, 25813 Musterwik.
items.computation: Letter dated 2025-09-01; assumed posted that day. Per the letter and Schleswig-Holstein administrative procedure law, it counts as announced on the 4th day after posting: 2025-09-05 (Friday). The one-month period starts the next day and ends on the same day number of the next month: 2025-10-05, a Sunday. Under § 31 VwVfG / § 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next working day, Monday 2025-10-06. It is not a public holiday in SH.

warnings: The letter does not state the day it was posted. The calculation assumes it was posted on the letter date, 2025-09-01. If it was posted later, the deadline moves later. To be safe, file by 2025-10-06 or earlier.
